gui.techquest.quests.title: Quests
gui.techquest.quest.select: Select a quest on the left. You can drag the tree with the mouse.
gui.techquest.quest.locked: Locked: claim the previous quests first
quest.techquest.missing_items: You don't have enough items to hand in
quest.techquest.welcome.title: Welcome
quest.techquest.welcome.desc: This is the TechQuest quest book. It will guide you from your first ore to your own power grid. Click a quest to see details and rewards. Press K to open the book.
quest.techquest.tin_ore.title: First Tin
quest.techquest.tin_ore.desc: Tin ore hides in stone between Y -40 and 56. You need a stone pickaxe to mine it.
quest.techquest.tin_ingot.title: Tin Ingots
quest.techquest.tin_ingot.desc: Smelt tin ore or raw tin in a furnace.
quest.techquest.bronze.title: The Bronze Age
quest.techquest.bronze.desc: Craft bronze: 3 copper ingots and 1 tin ingot make 4 bronze ingots.
quest.techquest.casing.title: Machine Casing
quest.techquest.casing.desc: The base of every machine: 8 bronze ingots around an iron ingot.
quest.techquest.generator.title: First Power
quest.techquest.generator.desc: Place a coal generator and feed it coal. It only accepts coal and charcoal: one piece gives 8000 FE.
quest.techquest.circuit.title: Electronics
quest.techquest.circuit.desc: A basic circuit: copper on the sides, iron in the middle, redstone above and below.
quest.techquest.macerator.title: Macerator
quest.techquest.macerator.desc: Grinds ore into dust, doubling the metal. Connect it to a generator directly or with a cable.
quest.techquest.dust.title: Ore Doubling
quest.techquest.dust.desc: Grind tin ore in the macerator. Dust smelts into ingots in a normal or electric furnace.
quest.techquest.cable.title: Wiring
quest.techquest.cable.desc: Tin cables connect to neighbouring machines automatically. They carry 100 FE/t.
quest.techquest.compressor.title: Compressor
quest.techquest.compressor.desc: Presses ingots into plates. Plates are needed for second-tier machines.
quest.techquest.plates.title: Sheet Metal
quest.techquest.plates.desc: Press 6 tin plates: they go into the electric furnace, panels and batteries.
quest.techquest.electric_furnace.title: Electric Furnace
quest.techquest.electric_furnace.desc: Smelts everything a normal furnace does, twice as fast and with no fuel.
quest.techquest.solar.title: Solar Power
quest.techquest.solar.desc: Produces 4 FE/t by day under open sky when it is not raining.
quest.techquest.battery.title: Energy Storage
quest.techquest.battery.desc: Stores up to 100,000 FE. Right-click it to see the charge.
quest.techquest.industrial.title: Industrial Age
quest.techquest.industrial.desc: You built a real power grid. This is only the beginning: more machines and ores are coming.
quest.techquest.wind.title: Catch the Wind
quest.techquest.wind.desc: Place the wind turbine under open sky. Right-click with a blade. Higher = more power.
quest.techquest.water.title: Water Power
quest.techquest.water.desc: Place the water wheel next to flowing or source water.
quest.techquest.lead.title: Heavy Metal
quest.techquest.lead.desc: Find lead ore underground. Useful for plates and later machines.
quest.techquest.silver.title: Silver Rush
quest.techquest.silver.desc: Silver is rarer. Smelt it for high-value components.
quest.techquest.drill.title: The Drill
quest.techquest.drill.desc: Build the drill as shown in the pictures, then Shift+Right-click the controller.
quest.techquest.alloy.title: Alloy Smelter
quest.techquest.alloy.desc: Stack: Casing / Smelter / Casing. Shift+Right-click to form.
message.techquest.wind.has_blades: Already has blades. Break to remove.
message.techquest.wind.need_sky: Need open sky above the turbine!
message.techquest.drill.hint3: 3) Drill Head under controller, then Shift+Right-click
message.techquest.water.nerfed: Water wheel generates less FE and slowly consumes water
